title: Micropayments for news
summary: Pay a few cents per article instead of subscribing.
whyTempting: People hate subscription walls but would pay for single articles.
whyItFails: Mental transaction cost. Every payment decision creates friction, even if tiny. Publishers prefer subscriptions. Recurring revenue beats per-article income. Chicken and egg. Needs many publishers and many wallets at once.
whatWouldChange: Wallet-level payments built into browsers or OSes with automatic budgets.

attempts.notes: Monthly micro-donations split across sites you visited; acquired by eyeo in 2017, closed November 2023.
Pay-per-article news; not profitable by 2019, sold to Cafeyn in 2020, micropayments ended in 2023.

reasons.detail: Mental transaction cost: Every payment decision creates friction, even if tiny.
Publishers prefer subscriptions: Recurring revenue beats per-article income.
Chicken and egg: Needs many publishers and many wallets at once.
